verdict.rationale: Live probes show LM Studio serves an llms.txt file at lmstudio.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with LM Studio-specific content) and markdown versions of its docs pages (e.g. /docs/app.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or advertising the llms.txt/markdown docs offering, evidence of how completely llms.txt covers the docs set (only a snippet was probed), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
